raw:
Agent Name: InformationVerification_Expert
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly parsed the Wikipedia page by assuming a span with id="Discography" followed immediately by a single <ul>. This structure didn’t exist, causing an AttributeError and preventing extraction of the discography. Even in the follow-up they looked only for an immediate <ul> sibling, failing to handle Wikipedia’s nested Discography subheadings (e.g., “Studio albums”). This parsing error blocked identifying the 2000–2009 studio albums and thus the correct count (3).
